sections.h2: Selling a house in Bristol, TN
sections.html:
Bristol, Tennessee sits in Sullivan County and touches Bristol, Virginia along State Street. The two cities keep separate governments, police departments and libraries, so a Tennessee seller deals with Tennessee offices only. Tennessee law and Tennessee taxes apply to a house on this side of the line.

The population was estimated at 28,107 on July 1, 2025, a 3.7 percent gain on April 2020. Owners live in 67.4 percent of homes, and a typical owned home is valued at $194,500. At that price level, a few thousand dollars of repairs or back taxes changes what you walk away with, so compare offers by what you keep after closing, not by the headline number.

This is an older, lower-cost market with a sizable renter share. Adults past 65 make up 19.5 percent of the population, and household income in the middle of the range is $58,162.

sections.h2: Bristol property tax rates after the reappraisal
sections.html:
A Bristol house is taxed by two governments, Sullivan County and the City of Bristol, Tennessee. For tax year 2025 the county rate is $1.6129 per hundred dollars of assessed value, the state-certified figure replacing a 2024 rate of $2.4962. The city rate is $1.87. City homeowners therefore carry $3.4829 per hundred dollars together.

The reappraisal reset property values, so the state certified a revenue-neutral city rate of $1.5397. The city's $1.87 sits 21.45 percent above that certified level. The 2024 city rate had been $2.25 on the older values.

The county assessor runs a countywide reappraisal every two years, and the next is scheduled for 2027. Residential property is assessed at 25 percent of value. Your own notice shows the exact amount you owe.

sections.h2: Paying Sullivan County taxes and getting relief
sections.html:
Bills are payable through the end of February. The Trustee's main office is at 3411 Highway 126, Suite 104, Blountville, phone 423-323-6464. A Bristol office runs on Thursdays and Fridays from October 1 through March 13 at the Ralph Harr Justice Center, 801 Anderson Street, Room 139, phone 423-354-7037.

The county also runs a payment plan that splits an expected bill into ten equal monthly payments beginning in March. For older, disabled and veteran homeowners, a state tax relief program exists. For 2025 taxes the income cap was $37,530 based on 2024 income, with an additional $85 rebate from the county for elderly and disabled participants.

  • Homeowners older than 65 can qualify if combined income, including a spouse or co-owner, is within the cap.
  • Disabled homeowners recognized by the Social Security Administration use the same income cap.
  • Permanently and totally disabled veterans, and their surviving spouses, qualify without that cap.

Ask the Trustee which year's limits apply before you file.

sections.h2: Is there a way to challenge a Sullivan County value?
sections.html:
Call the county assessor at 3411 Highway 126, Suite 103, Blountville, phone 423-323-6455. If the answer leaves you unconvinced, take the dispute to the county equalization board. The assessor's office does not set the tax rate, send the bill or collect payment, so a rate complaint goes elsewhere.

A disputed value generally has to reach the local board first. If you disagree with that ruling, the state filing is due by August 1 of the tax year or 45 days after the local notice, whichever is later. Hearings before an administrative judge turn on evidence, and comparable sales are the best proof for a house.

While a challenge is open, pay the undisputed portion of the tax before the delinquency date. Unpaid amounts can bring penalties or a dismissal.

For zoning questions on a particular lot, call the Department of Development Services before you plan a rental or an addition, since use rules differ by district. Council meetings are held at the Slater Community Center, 325 McDowell Street, and the city's legal notices page posts agendas ahead of time, along with hearings on budgets and tax rates.

Bristol deeds are filed in Blountville with the Sullivan County Register of Deeds, 3411 Highway 126, Suite 101, phone 423-323-6420. The counter is staffed from 8 in the morning until 4:30 on weekdays. The state transfer tax is 37 cents per $100 of price.

Have the title company prorate the year's property tax on the closing statement.

  • Gather a payoff letter from each lienholder before closing.
  • Confirm who signs for any estate or co-owner situation.
  • Check the Trustee's record for unpaid prior-year taxes, which the title company will expect to see settled at closing.

You can sell a Bristol house that has unpaid taxes. The balance is paid from your proceeds at the closing table, so there is nothing to bring in cash. Ask the Sullivan County Trustee for the current balance before you choose a closing date, because interest keeps growing until it is paid.

A cash buyer can often close faster when the title is clean, and skips repairs and showings. A listing takes longer but may bring more money if the house is in decent shape. In either case, line up your payoff letters, your latest tax notice and the names of everyone on the deed, and ask the buyer in writing for the closing date and the title company that will run the closing. Then compare offers by what you take home after taxes, payoff and recording.

faqs.q: How much is the Bristol, TN property tax rate?
faqs.a: For tax year 2025 the city levies $1.87 per hundred dollars of assessed value and the county levies $1.6129, which totals $3.4829. Rates are set annually, so confirm the current numbers with the Trustee.

faqs.q: When are Sullivan County property taxes due?
faqs.a: Bills are payable through the end of February, and the Trustee's office in Blountville answers at 423-323-6464. Ask for the interest schedule on late payments.

faqs.q: Can I sell a Bristol house with unpaid taxes?
faqs.a: Yes. Back taxes are normally paid from your proceeds at the closing table. Ask the Sullivan County Trustee for the current balance before choosing a date.

faqs.q: Where is the Bristol Tennessee Register of Deeds?
faqs.a: It sits at 3411 Highway 126, Suite 101, in Blountville, and the phone number is 423-323-6420. Weekday hours run from 8 am to 4:30 pm, except on designated holidays.

faqs.q: Is Bristol, Tennessee the same as Bristol, Virginia?
faqs.a: No. They are two cities with separate governments that share a border at State Street. A house on the Tennessee side uses Sullivan County offices, Tennessee law and Tennessee taxes.
